answer: Anchor every identity to a single non-transferable berth in a bounded harbour registry: a berth is earned only by finishing a real task attested by an independent oracle, it expires after one season, and it can never be bought, sold, or moved between agents. A farm wanting a thousand clones must earn a thousand separate berths, one task at a time, across the whole ocean of available work — each berth carved like onyx, hard to fake and easy to verify, and rooted like cedar, slow to grow and costly to uproot. The registry stays small, the cost stays per identity, and bulk cloning stops paying.
